modules.title: Data Privacy
modules.purpose: To ensure intermediate HR and hotel staff understand and execute strict guest and employee data privacy controls, secure handling of personal information, reporting requirements for data incidents, and compliant consent management at Malaysian properties.
assessment_topics: Data Privacy and Information Security Policies
modules.completion_criteria: Complete all required checklists, submit the HR audit task, participate in the scenario simulation, and achieve at least 80% on the final knowledge quiz.

content.text: Explain and apply purpose limitation rules, preventing unauthorized access to guest personal data and restrictions on sharing salary and disciplinary details.
Identify secure data handling protocols including prohibitions on using personal devices, personal cloud storage, and USB drives for guest or employee data.
Execute correct procedures for handling callers, visitors, Malaysian property consent notices, and reporting data security incidents within the mandated timeframe.

content.description: Review internal HR personnel file access controls and verify that salary and disciplinary information sharing complies with minimum necessary standards.
content.expected_outcome: An audited review confirming all HR file sharing practices align strictly with approved HR processes.
content.completion_criteria: Submit an audit checklist demonstrating zero unauthorized sharing of salary or disciplinary records beyond the approved minimum necessary.

content.situation: A visitor approaches the front desk asking for the room number and name confirmation of a registered guest. Simultaneously, a staff member receives a guest's passport copy on a personal smartphone for check-in verification.
expected_actions: Refuse to disclose room numbers or guest names to the visitor, and instead connect the call or visitor to the room without confirming presence.
Immediately delete any guest identity documents received on personal mobile phones, ensuring they are never received, photographed, or stored on personal messaging apps.

content.question: Within what timeframe must Guest Data Privacy training be completed by employees whose roles involve guest personal data?
content.explanation: Guest Data Privacy training must be completed within Week 1 as mandated by R-GDP-01-001 and R-CMP-01-002.

content.question: Guest personal data may be accessed freely by any hotel employee at any time for general curiosity.
content.explanation: Guest personal data may only be accessed to deliver the guest's stay or for a documented business need.

options: They may be stored if encrypted.
They may be photographed for quick check-in only.
They must never be received, photographed or stored on personal mobile phones or messaging apps.
They can be transferred to personal cloud storage if deleted afterward.
content.question: What is the rule regarding guest identity documents and personal mobile devices?
content.explanation: Guest identity documents must never be received, photographed or stored on personal mobile phones or messaging apps.

options: Confirm the room number if they know the guest's full name.
Do not disclose room numbers or guest names; connect calls to the room without confirming presence.
Give out the room number after verifying caller identification.
content.question: How should callers and visitors asking for a guest's room number or presence be handled?
content.explanation: Room numbers and guest names must not be disclosed to callers or visitors; calls are to be connected to the room without confirming the guest's presence.

options: At checkout before settling the final bill.
At check-in before any marketing preferences are recorded.
Only if they request promotional materials.
Within 24 hours after arrival via email.
content.question: At Aurelle Langkawi Shores (a Malaysian property), when must guests sign the Personal Data Consent Notice?
content.explanation: At Malaysian properties, guests must sign the Personal Data Consent Notice at check-in before any marketing preferences are recorded.

options: By the end of the work week
content.question: Within what time frame must any suspected loss or disclosure of guest data be reported?
content.explanation: Any suspected loss or disclosure of guest data must be reported to the Duty Manager and IT within 1 hour of discovery.

content.topic: Data Privacy and Information Security Policies

rubric.criterion: Understanding Purpose Limitation and Access Rules
rubric.pass_condition: Answers related quiz questions and audit checks correctly with zero violations.
rubric.expected_performance: Accurately identifies when guest and employee data can be accessed and shared.

rubric.criterion: Compliance with Device and Storage Restrictions
rubric.pass_condition: Correctly applies prohibitions in scenarios and tasks.
rubric.expected_performance: Demonstrates strict adherence against using personal devices or USB/cloud storage for data.

rubric.criterion: Malaysian Property Procedures and Caller Protocols
rubric.pass_condition: Identifies correct protocols for visitor/caller inquiries and regional consent timing.
rubric.expected_performance: Applies correct check-in consent notice procedures and caller handling rules.

rubric.pass_condition: Successfully reports simulated incidents within the mandated timeframe.
rubric.expected_performance: Recognizes the 1-hour reporting window and Week 1 training requirements.

modules.title: Fire & Life Safety
modules.purpose: To ensure all employees at Aurelle Langkawi Shores understand fire and life safety procedures, emergency protocols, and mandatory drill requirements on their first day and throughout their employment.
modules.completion_criteria: Successful completion of Day 1 orientation, completion of the workstation safety mapping task, and passing the module quiz with all requirements met.

content.text: Complete fire and life safety orientation on the first day of employment.
Identify workplace fire assembly points, the two nearest fire exits, and execute the RACE procedure correctly during emergencies.
Participate in mandatory fire drills conducted every six months.

content.activity: Complete fire and life safety orientation on Day 1

content.description: Locate and document the exact locations of the fire assembly point and the two nearest fire exits for your assigned work area.
content.expected_outcome: A completed workstation safety map identifying the assembly point and two closest fire exits.
content.completion_criteria: Successfully walk the area, identify the designated assembly point, and note the two nearest exits without error.

content.situation: You hear the fire alarm sounding in your office building. You need to evacuate immediately and notice guests and colleagues moving towards the elevators.
expected_actions: Follow the RACE procedure (Rescue, Alarm, Contain, Evacuate)
Strictly avoid using the lifts
Proceed to the designated fire assembly point

content.question: Fire and life safety orientation must be completed on your first day.
content.explanation: Fire and Life Safety orientation must be completed on Day 1.

content.question: When must every new employee attend a fire and life safety orientation?
content.explanation: Every new employee must attend a fire and life safety orientation on their first day.

options: The location of the fire assembly point
content.question: What locations must employees know for their work area? (Select all that apply)
content.explanation: Employees must know the location of the fire assembly point and the two nearest fire exits for their work area.

content.question: You hear the fire alarm ring. According to the RACE procedure, which of the following actions is strictly prohibited during evacuation?
content.explanation: On hearing the fire alarm, employees must follow the RACE procedure (Rescue, Alarm, Contain, Evacuate) and must not use the lifts.

content.question: How often must all employees participate in a fire drill?
content.explanation: All employees must participate in a fire drill every six months.

rubric.pass_condition: Correctly answers orientation timing questions.
rubric.expected_performance: Understands that fire and life safety orientation is completed on Day 1.

rubric.pass_condition: Completes the workstation safety map task successfully.
rubric.expected_performance: Identifies assembly points and two nearest fire exits.

rubric.pass_condition: Achieves 100% on safety scenario and quiz questions regarding evacuation.
rubric.expected_performance: Demonstrates full knowledge of RACE, lift restrictions, and drill frequency.

Blackout dates and medical certificate rules

expected_actions: Identify that annual leave requests must be submitted at least 14 days in advance.
Recognize that annual leave cannot be approved during published property blackout dates unless a documented emergency exists.
Deny or redirect the leave request through the HR portal based on policy rules.

options: In physical paper folders in the manager's desk
content.question: Where must employee personal files be stored according to company policy?
content.explanation: Employee personal files must be accessed only by Human Resources and stored in the HR system, never in shared drives.

options: 40 hours per week across five shifts
48 hours per week across six shifts
37.5 hours per week across five shifts
50 hours per week across six shifts
content.question: What is the standard working time per week and shift structure across Aurelle?
content.explanation: Standard working time is 48 hours per week across six shifts; overtime is required to be approved in advance by the department head.

content.question: Absence due to illness must be reported to the supervisor at least two hours before the start of the shift.
content.explanation: Absence due to illness must be reported to the supervisor at least two hours before the start of the shift.

options: 30 calendar days, accrued monthly from the date of joining
30 working days, accrued upfront on January 1st
content.question: How many days of annual leave are employees entitled to per year, and how do they accrue?
content.explanation: Employees are entitled to 30 calendar days of annual leave per year, accrued monthly from the date of joining.

options: Maximum of 10 days; lapse on 31 December
Maximum of 5 days; lapse on 31 March
Maximum of 5 days; lapse on 30 June
content.question: What is the maximum number of unused annual leave days that can be carried forward, and when do excess days lapse?
content.explanation: A maximum of 5 unused annual leave days may be carried forward to the next year; any excess days lapse on 31 March.

content.explanation: Sick leave of more than two consecutive days must be supported by a medical certificate submitted within 48 hours of return.

modules.completion_criteria: Successfully complete all checklist acknowledgments, submit the required task summary, and pass the knowledge assessment with a score of 80% or higher.

expected_actions: Immediately report the injury to the Manager on Duty (MOD) within the 15-minute timeframe.

options: Before the end of the shift

options: Before the end of the shift

options: Uniforms must be washed at home using gentle cycle.

Uniforms can be cleaned at any local dry cleaner of choice.

content.explanation: Uniforms must be returned to the Uniform Room for laundering; washing uniforms at home is not permitted.
